# Sonicker

> Free AI voice platform — text-to-speech, voice cloning, voice design, and sound effects generation. 260+ curated voices across 10 languages. No download needed, works in your browser.

For full documentation, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.sonicker.com/llms-full.txt).

## Core Features

- **AI Text-to-Speech**: Convert text to natural speech with 260+ curated AI voices in 10 languages.
- **Voice Cloning**: Clone any voice from a 3-second audio sample. Upload a file or record directly in the browser.
- **Voice Design**: Create a custom voice by describing it in words — no recording needed. Specify age, accent, tone, and personality.
- **AI Sound Effects**: Generate sound effects from text prompts — explosions, rain, alarms, crowd cheering, cinematic impacts, and more.
- **Free to Start**: Sign up free, no credit card required. All features available with credits.

## Free Tools

- [AI Text-to-Speech](https://www.sonicker.com/text-to-speech) — Turn text into lifelike speech with 260+ AI voices.
- [AI Voice Cloning](https://www.sonicker.com/voice-cloning) — Clone a voice from 3 seconds of audio. Upload or record in browser.
- [AI Voice Design](https://www.sonicker.com/voice-design) — Design a custom AI voice from a text description, no recording needed.
- [AI Sound Effects Generator](https://www.sonicker.com/sound-effects) — Generate any sound effect from a text prompt.
- [AI Voice Library](https://www.sonicker.com/voices) — Browse 260+ voices: celebrity, anime character, narrator, and more.

## Use Cases

- **YouTube & Video Production**: Add professional voiceover to videos without hiring voice talent.
- **Podcasting**: Create multi-voice episodes, clone your own voice for editing consistency.
- **Game Development**: Voice NPCs, characters, and tutorials with distinct AI voices.
- **E-Learning**: Produce multilingual course narration at scale.
- **Audiobook Production**: Generate chapter narrations with consistent character voices.
- **Content Creation**: Create TikTok/Reels voiceovers, meme audio, and viral sound effects.
- **Sound Design**: Generate custom SFX for films, games, and apps without a sound library subscription.

## Pricing

- **Free**: $0/month — 120 char limit, voice cloning, voice design, sound effects included
- **Basic**: $9.9/month — 500 credits/month, 2000 char limit
- **Professional**: $19.9/month — 1500 credits/month, commercial use included
- **Enterprise**: $49.9/month — dedicated support, larger credit allocation
- Voice design access: all signed-in users
